title: Gin Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Send a text reply
entries.summary: GET /hello calls this handler. Context.String sends formatted text with a status.
notes: Use a matching HTTP method and path.

entries.name: Send a JSON object
entries.summary: gin.H is a short map type for named data. Open GET /book.
notes: Use c.JSON so the response has the right content type.

entries.name: Read a path parameter
entries.summary: A colon marks a route value. GET /hello/Ravi puts Ravi in the name parameter.
notes: A route value is text until it is parsed and checked.

entries.name: Read a query value
entries.summary: DefaultQuery reads a query parameter and supplies a fallback. GET /page uses the text fallback 1.
notes: Query values are strings, even when they look like numbers.

entries.name: Parse a number
entries.summary: strconv.Atoi turns text into an int or reports an error. Open GET /double/4.
notes: Always check the parse error before using the number.

entries.name: Read a JSON body
entries.summary: ShouldBindJSON reads and checks JSON fields. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
notes: Pass a pointer so the binder can fill the struct.

entries.name: Share a route prefix
entries.summary: A group gives related handlers a common path prefix. Open GET /api/books.
notes: The group prefix belongs in the requested URL.

entries.name: Run a shared request step
entries.summary: Middleware can set request values before calling the next handler. Open GET /school.
notes: Request context values belong to the current request.

entries.name: Add response metadata
entries.summary: Header sets a response header. Open GET /note and inspect Cache-Control.
notes: Set headers before writing the response body.

entries.name: Return a redirect
entries.summary: Redirect asks the client to visit a new URL. GET /start ends at /hello in a browser.
notes: A redirect is a second client request.

entries.name: Handle unmatched routes
entries.summary: NoRoute supplies a fallback handler. GET /missing has no normal route.
notes: Keep the 404 status even with a friendly body.

entries.name: Stop a handler chain
entries.summary: AbortWithStatusJSON stops later handlers in the chain. GET /closed receives this practice block message.
notes: Abort stops later handlers but does not return from the current Go function.
